title: Chapupu cheMoto
intro: Munhu akadzikama, akazvipira kuwana chokwadi chekupedzisira, akatanga rwendo rwekudzidza zvemweya. Kutenda kwavo kwakasimba kwakaita kuti vapikise tsika dzakagara dziripo, vachitarisana nemiedzo mikuru yakaedza miganhu yekutenda. Nyaya yemweya uyu uchapupu hwedziviriro nenhungamiro yaMwari.
clues: Ndakakomborerwa nezita rekuremekedza kubva kuna Ishe wangu, zvichireva chisungo chakadzama uye chakakosha.
Hupenyu hwangu hwepakutanga ndakahupedza ndiri pakati pevanhu vaipfugamira mifananidzo yakagadzirwa, asi moyo wangu waida Mwari Mumwe Chete Wechokwadi.
Ndakatarisa mitumbi yekudenga, zuva, mwedzi, nenyeredzi, ndichifungisisa nezvekumuka nekudonha kwayo, ndichigumisa kuti haigone kuva Ishe wangu.
Muchiito chekuramba kunamata vanamwari vakawanda kwakapararira, ndakatarisana nevanamwari venhema, ndichisiya mumwe ari ega, mukuru asina kupomerwa semupomeri akanyarara.
Kupikisa kwangu kunamata zvidhori kwakaita kuti ndirangwe zvakanyanya, sezvo ndakatongerwa kukandwa mumoto unopisa kwazvo.
Asi, nemurairo weMusiki wangu, marimi emoto akasimba akashanduka kuita sosi yekutonhorera nekuchengetedzwa, achichengetedza hupenyu hwangu.
arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire." (37:97)
